title: Handling of the periodic tracking area update timer and mobile reachable timer (S1 mode only)

entities.name: Periodic Tracking Area Updating Procedure
entities.description: Procedure used to periodically notify UE availability to the network. Controlled by timer T3412 in the UE.

entities.name: Timer T3412
entities.description: Periodic tracking area update timer in UE. Value sent by network in ATTACH ACCEPT or TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT messages.

entities.name: Mobile Reachable Timer
entities.description: Network timer supervising UE periodic tracking area updates. Typically 4 minutes longer than T3412 for non-emergency services.

entities.name: Implicit Detach Timer
entities.description: Network timer started after mobile reachable timer expiry. If expires before UE contact, network implicitly detaches UE.

entities.name: Timer T3423
entities.description: Timer started when T3412 expires and T3346 is running or UE is in specific states. Used for delayed TAU procedure.

entities.name: EMM-REGISTERED.NORMAL-SERVICE
entities.description: UE state where normal EMM services are available. Periodic TAU procedure requires this state.

entities.name: EMM-CONNECTED
entities.description: UE state with active NAS signalling connection. T3412 is stopped in this state.

entities.name: EMM-IDLE
entities.description: UE state without active NAS signalling connection. T3412 is reset and started when entering this state.

entities.name: EMM-DEREGISTERED
entities.description: UE state where UE is not registered with network. T3412 is stopped in this state.

entities.name: UE attached for emergency bearer services
entities.description: Condition where UE is attached specifically for emergency services. Affects T3412 behavior and mobile reachable timer settings.

entities.name: T3412 extended value IE
entities.description: Information element containing extended value for timer T3412, sent in ATTACH ACCEPT or TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT messages.

entities.name: Local detach from network
entities.description: Behavior where UE or network locally detaches without explicit detach procedure. Occurs when T3412 expires for emergency-attached UE.

relations.description: Periodic TAU procedure is controlled by timer T3412
T3412 is reset and started when UE changes to EMM-IDLE mode
T3412 is stopped when UE enters EMM-CONNECTED mode
T3412 is stopped when UE enters EMM-DEREGISTERED state
When UE is attached for emergency services and T3412 expires, UE locally detaches
Periodic TAU procedure is delayed until UE returns to EMM-REGISTERED.NORMAL-SERVICE
When T3412 expires and certain conditions are met, T3423 is started
Upon expiry of mobile reachable timer, implicit detach timer is started
T3412 extended value IE provides the value for timer T3412
Mobile reachable timer is set equal to T3412 when UE is attached for emergency services
